coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: Arterra
record.summary: Arterra, an apartment building at 300 Berry St.

notes.accuracy_caveat: REAL -- surveyed OpenStreetMap building footprint(s), not a hand trace or plan estimate. The underlying Assessor parcel is condo-mapped across many individually owned per-unit lots (confirmed against DataSF's Assessor parcel data), so no single blklot represents the whole building and it cannot be mapped from one parcel the way a single-owner building can. Using the real building footprint from OSM instead of a fabricated or arbitrarily chosen 'representative' unit lot, the same pattern already used for Mission Bay's other condo-mapped residential towers (Avalon I, Madrone and Radiance, re-checked against DataSF's parcel data in September 2026; Avalon II and III are not condo-mapped, and Arden and One Mission Bay were not re-checked).

milestones.text: Arterra (300 Berry St) tops off at 16 floors per Intracorp, which expected completion and closing of escrows in spring 2008
Arterra (300 Berry St) completed: the per-unit condominium lots carry year built 2009 in the DataSF Assessor roll

changes.text: The map notes said about 275 units; the cited SocketSite post says 268, so a dated note was added. The 2009 built year now cites the DataSF Assessor roll for the per-unit condominium lots at 300 Berry, the 2007 topping-out milestone cites its SocketSite post (16 floors, spring 2008 target), and the comparison with other condo-mapped towers no longer lists Avalon II and III.
